description: Get a signed, time-limited (1 hour) download URL for a dataset the agent already has access to. All full downloads require account authentication. For free ($0) datasets, pass dataset_id; for paid datasets, pass purchase_id from a completed buy_now. URLs expire after 1 hour — call again for a fresh one. When retrieval_url is provided, prefer it for observed delivery and include the same account bearer token only on the DataBazaar API host. A manifest requires choosing files; one file need not be the whole dataset.

dataset_id.description: Dataset ID — use this for free ($0) datasets. Account authentication required; no purchase needed.

purchase_id.description: Purchase ID from buy_now — use this for paid datasets.

name: get_download_url
